# Testing

## Framework
The repo uses Frappe's test runner (unittest-based) through bench. There are no JS or Vue unit tests.

## Layout
- Tests live next to each doctype as `healthcare/healthcare/doctype/<name>/test_<name>.py` (about 85 test files). Shared tests are in `healthcare/tests/`.
- **Base class:** every test class extends `HealthcareTestSuite` from `healthcare/tests/utils.py`. That class extends ERPNext's `ERPNextTestSuite`. Recent commits migrated all fork tests to it, so do not use `FrappeTestCase` or `unittest.TestCase` directly.
- **Fixtures:** `BootStrapTestData` creates master data: company, items, departments, users, patients, practitioners, service units, templates, insurance payors and more. Tests look up records with `frappe.get_list("Patient", pluck="name")[0]` instead of creating them ad hoc.
- **`setUp`** must call `super().setUp()`. It may clean tables with `frappe.db.sql("delete from `tabX`")` and toggle settings via `frappe.db.set_single_value("Healthcare Settings", ...)`.
- **Helpers:** module-level `create_<thing>()` helpers inside test files, e.g. `create_appointment` and `create_encounter`, are reused across tests.
- Name fixture records with a `_Test ` prefix.

## Running
Run `bench --site test_site run-tests --app healthcare [--doctype "..."]`. CI uses `run-parallel-tests` against MariaDB 11.8.

## Coverage
- Coverage is captured only on non-PR (scheduled) runs and uploaded to Codecov.
- `codecov.yml` sets the **patch target at 85%** on PRs to `develop`, and allows project drops of up to 0.5%.
- New behaviour needs a test in the doctype's `test_*.py`.

## Fork baseline
According to `wiki/upstream-sync-version-16.md`, `ci.yml` has no run history on `biograph-fh`. Record any pre-existing failures there rather than assuming a green baseline.
